about: Which side of the track each platform is on, from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). side: left/right for a train travelling on heading (compass degrees); the other way round it is the other side. terminal: a buffer stop lies ahead on heading, so arriving trains always travel on it. light: an S-Bahn or Stadtbahn station of its own, used for S-Bahn trains only. Generated by scripts/make-exit-sides.py; corrections go into ExitSideOverrides.json.
